findings.title: Shipping banner shows incorrect message for exactly $50.00
findings.detail: The shipping_banner function returns 'Add $0.00 more...' for exactly $50.00 instead of 'Your order ships free!'. This is because the condition checks 'remaining < 0' instead of 'remaining <= 0'. [upgraded to blocking: probe confirmed by execution; reviewer said major]
findings.evidence: When subtotal is 50.0, remaining is 0.0, so the 'if remaining < 0' condition is false, and the function returns 'Add $0.00 more...' instead of the correct message.
findings.suggestion: Change the condition in shipping_banner from 'if remaining < 0' to 'if remaining <= 0'.
